Here’s a really simple and delicious dinner idea! Let me know if you give it a go 😄 Chris x CREAM CHEESE CHICKEN | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN: 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, brought close to room temp 1/2 tsp EACH: Smoked Paprika, Salt 1/4 tsp EACH: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Dried Oregano, Black Pepper, plus more to serve 1/8 tsp Dried Thyme 1 tbsp EACH: Unsalted Butter, Olive Oil ➡️SAUCE: 2 Shallots, very finely diced 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock (use low-salt if sensitive to salt) 1x 165g/5.8oz tub of full-fat Cream Cheese, brought close to room temp (I use Philadelphia) 1 tsp Dijon Mustard finely diced Fresh Chives, to serve METHOD 1️⃣Horizontally slice each chicken breast right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Combine the seasoning mix in a small pot or bowl, then evenly sprinkle over both sides of each breast. 2️⃣Place a large pan over medium-high heat and stir in the butter and oil. Add the chicken and fry for a few minutes on each side, or until lightly charred on the outside and piping hot/white through the centre. Remove and place on a plate to one side then lower the heat to medium. 3️⃣Add the shallots and fry in the leftover fat until soft and golden. Pour in the stock, then stir in the cream cheese until it blends into a sauce. You'll need to give it a good whisk to smooth out all the small lumps. Stir in the dijon, then stir in the resting juices from the chicken. 4️⃣The sauce should be relatively thick already, but if it's not just gently simmer for a couple of minutes. If you over thicken it just stir in a splash more stock or water to thin it out. 5️⃣Add the chicken back in and baste in the sauce, then sprinkle with chives and a pinch of black pepper. Serve up and enjoy!

Heaven in one single pan 🤤  Ingredients:  • 4-6 chicken tenderloins • 2 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ¼ tsp salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 3/4 jar of sun dried tomatoes (in oil) • 1 cup orzo, uncooked • 2 cups chicken stock • 1/2 bag fresh spinach • ½ cup heavy cream • 1 tbsp dried basil • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (more if you like it spicy) • parmesan for garnish Recipe: 	1.	Heat up 2 tbsp of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 	2.	Season the sh*t out of that chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper 	3.	Sear for 3 minutes per side until golden and gorgeous, then yeet it out of the pan. 	4.	Add another splash of olive oil, garlic, chopped sun-dried tomatoes, and orzo.  	5.	Toast the orzo for 2 minutes  	6.	Pour in chicken stock + a sprinkle of salt, bring it to a boil, then cover so she can simmer down. 	7.	Cook for 5–8 minutes until the orzo is tender. Stir occasionally so it doesn’t stick like your ex. 	8.	Toss in spinach, cook till wilted (about 2–3 minutes, same amount of time it takes me to spiral). 	9.	Add heavy cream, dried basil, and red pepper flakes. Mix. 	10.	Add chicken back into the pan, let it simmer 2–5 minutes. 	11.	Finish with parmesan on top!  #easydinner #dinnerideas #yummydinner #easyrecipes #madeandtaylored

Ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 small onion, finely diced 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup long-grain white rice 2 1/2 cups chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup frozen peas and carrots 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1/4 teaspoon paprika 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley Directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter with olive oil. Season diced chicken with salt and pepper, then sauté until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove chicken and set aside. In the same skillet, add the onion and garlic. Sauté for 2-3 minutes until fragrant and softened. Stir in the rice, coating it in the butter and oil, and cook for 1-2 minutes to lightly toast. Pour in the chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover. Simmer for 18-20 minutes until the rice is tender and broth is absorbed. Stir in the heavy cream, cooked chicken, frozen peas and carrots, Parmesan cheese, and paprika. Cook another 5 minutes until creamy and heated through. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cooking Time: 30 minutes | Total Time: 40 minutes Kcal: 545 kcal | Servings: 4 servings

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

🍋 5 MINUTE DINNER IDEA: Creamy Lemon Chicken Thigh Orzo Bake Ingredients 	•	1 cup uncooked orzo 	•	1¾ cups chicken broth (warm) 	•	½ cup heavy cream 	•	2–3 boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces 	•	1 cup fresh spinach 	•	½ cup grated parmesan 	•	2 cloves garlic, minced (or 1 tsp garlic powder) 	•	1 tbsp lemon juice 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp pepper 	•	½ tsp Italian seasoning & paprika 	•	1 tbsp olive oil Optional topping: 	•	extra parmesan or mozzarella Instructions 	1.	Preheat oven to 400°F. 	2.	In an 8×8 or similar baking dish, add: 	•	orzo 	•	warm chicken broth 	•	cream 	•	garlic 	•	lemon juice 	•	salt, pepper, Italian seasoning 	3.	Stir in the chicken pieces and spinach, making sure the orzo is mostly submerged. 	4.	Drizzle olive oil over the chicken. 	5.	Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes. 	6.	Remove foil, stir gently, sprinkle parmesan on top, and bake 5–10 more minutes uncovered until: 	•	orzo is tender 	•	chicken reaches 165° F

Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp dried thyme Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Season both sides with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake:  * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes  * Regular or thick chicken breasts (or thighs): 30–40 minutes 5. 10-15 min before chicken is done remove from the oven, add the vegetables, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the top. 6. Return to the oven uncovered for the 10-15 minutes remaining or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or your favorite side. Enjoy! #fyp #easydinner #recipes

Ingredients (4 Servings) Chicken: * 1½ lbs chicken thighs, cubed * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tbsp olive oil Honey Garlic Sauce: * ⅓ cup honey * ¼ cup soy sauce * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water Rice & Garnish: * 2 cups cooked jasmine rice * Green onions * Sesame seeds  Instructions: 1️⃣ Cook the Chicken (8 Minutes) Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken with: * paprika * garlic powder * salt * pepper Cook 6–8 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. 2️⃣ Make the Sauce (3 Minutes) In a bowl combine: * honey * soy sauce * garlic * rice vinegar Pour into skillet. Mix cornstarch and water separately, then add to skillet. Cook 2–3 minutes until thick, sticky, and glossy. 3️⃣ Assemble (2 Minutes) Add rice to serving bowls. Top with sticky honey garlic chicken. Garnish with: * green onions * sesame seeds #easyrecipe #foodrecipe #dinnerideas #quickmeals #foodtiktok

My family went crazy for this one and it’s super easy for a weeknight dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast  1/2 cup corn starch  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each garlic powder and onion powder  3-4 tbsp peanut oil  1/3 cup honey 1/4 cup soy sauce  2 tbsp minced garlic  1 tbsp apple cider vinegar  1 tbsp ketchup 1 tsp sesame oil  1 tbsp cornstarch (mixed with 2 tbsp water for slurry)  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut your chicken into bite sized pieces and add to a large bowl. Add 1/2 cup corn starch, salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder. Toss until well coated. Next, add 3-4 tablespoons of peanut oil to a pan on medium-high heat. Once the oil is hot add the chicken evenly to the bottom of the pan and allow it to cook for 3-4 minutes before stirring and cooking until crispy and golden on all sides.  Once the chicken is cooked remove it from the pan and set aside.  To make the sauce lower the heat in that same pan and add in 1/3 cup honey, 1/4 cup of soy sauce, 2 Tbsp minced garlic, 1 Tbsp each of apple cider vinegar and ketchup, and a teaspoon of sesame oil.  Allow that to simmer for 2 minutes before stirring in a  cornstarch slurry ( 1tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water) Once the sauce has thickened add your chicken back to the pan, toss to coat, and serve!  I like to top mine with sesame seeds and green onions. Enjoy! #easyrecipes #chicken #honeygarlic

Don’t know what to make for dinner? Make this! This Italian baked chicken with potatoes, red onion, olives, rosemary and white wine all cooks together in one pan. It’s an easy family dinner with simple ingredients and tons of flavor. The best part is dinners like this practically cook themselves, which makes them perfect for weeknights. Chicken and Potatoes Ingredients: 4 chicken legs 4 chicken thighs 4 Yukon Gold potatoes, cubed 1 large red onion, cut into large chunks 3/4 cup green olives 1/2 cup white wine Fresh rosemary Olive oil Salt & black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Add the chicken, potatoes, onion, olives and rosemary to a large baking tray. 3. Drizzle with olive oil, pour in the white wine and season with salt and pepper. 4. Toss everything together, then arrange the chicken skin-side up. 5. Bake for 1 hour, until the chicken is browned and the potatoes are tender. 6. Broil for a few minutes at the end for extra color. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Need an easy, incredibly delicious dinner for a busy weeknight? These creamy pan-seared chicken thighs are cozy, comforting, and full of flavor. Juicy chicken thighs, smoky paprika, a rich creamy sauce, and buttery mashed potatoes come together in one satisfying dinner that feels special without being complicated. Perfect for a weeknight dinner, Sunday family meal, or anytime you want something warm, hearty, and homemade. If you are looking for easy chicken dinner ideas, creamy comfort food, or a quick chicken recipe everyone will love, this one might become your new go-to.  Perfect for a weeknight dinner, Sunday family meal, or when you want an easy chicken recipe that feels a little more special. Ingredients: Chicken: • 1½ lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs • 1½ tsp sweet paprika • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ¼ tsp black pepper • Pinch of cayenne, optional • 1 tbsp butter • 1 tbsp oil from the sun-dried tomato jar Creamy paprika sauce: • 1 small red onion or 2 shallots • 3 garlic cloves • ⅓ cup (60 g) sun-dried tomatoes, finely chopped • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ¾ cup (180 ml) chicken stock • ¾ cup (180 ml) heavy cream • 1½ tsp Dijon mustard • Small squeeze of lemon juice, optional • Fresh parsley or chives, for serving Potato mash: • 2 lb (900 g) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks • 4 tbsp (55 g) butter • ½ cup (120 ml) warm heavy cream or whole milk • 1 tbsp sour cream or crème fraîche, optional • Salt, to taste • Black pepper, to taste
